three_month_context.note: Long-window context only; no causal attribution to September changes.

guardrails: 24h is descriptive only; do not compare its position with 28d.
Overlapping windows are observations, not independent experiments or deployment attribution.
Missing top-1000 query row = NO_CURRENT_BASELINE, not zero demand.
Exact query and contains-group aggregations are separate; no independent-dimension joins.
Country is searcher location, not a locale-site filter.
MONEY/SEASONAL_MONEY are procurement-intent labels, not observed enquiries/orders/revenue.
No AI citation/GEO growth claim without actual fixed-kit probes and citation URLs.
